question: On the same J6M periodic anyon-free orbit, does an actual first green-star projector followed by a prescribed red-X action give normalized, action-dependent second blue-star charge probabilities on flux-free sites?
epistemic_role: Exact local sequential two-projector gate; not a full 24-site public E2 instrument or five-round schedule channel
source_basis: Jing et al. 2025 Appendix A.1 Eqs. (A2)-(A4), A.2 Eqs. (A5)-(A6), A.4 Eqs. (A13)-(A14)
J6L exact periodic red-edge/star/triangle map and J6M compact common +1 state

fixed_case.lattice: J6L/J6M periodic L=2, 108 kagome qubits, one fixed compact anyon-free orbit from |0^108>
fixed_case.first_measurement: A_green:1 with outcomes +1/-1 after the physical red-X error, before any action
fixed_case.second_measurement_rule: Only measure A_s when both local triangle projectors are +1 after action; defer has no E2. Other stars and full public E2 are not generated.

method: Use P_a=(I+aA_green:1)/2 and exact joint Born weight <psi|E P_a C P_b C P_a E|psi> with E and C Pauli-X red-edge strings. Reduce each star conjugation by E or E XOR C to a signed Z mask times its source CZ-aware A_s. Since every A_s fixes the J6M state, an ordered product reduces to a signed diagonal Z mask. Its expectation is 1 iff that mask is orthogonal to the rank-33 orbit flip span, otherwise 0. Check all local triangle eigenvalues before publishing a second charge outcome. This analytic orbit-character calculation does not enumerate 2^33 amplitudes.

matrix.second_sites: zero for defer, one for partial, two for matched
matrix.independent_unit: one deterministic exact periodic state and fixed physical error; no Monte Carlo units

acceptance: Pinned PDF/J6L/J6M hashes match; physical edge IDs, star colors, triangle eigenvalues and J6M rank-33 orbit are reproduced exactly.
First green outcomes normalize and have the source A6 half/half limit; all eligible conditioned second-site rows are nonnegative and normalize separately for each first result.
Matched action reproduces the source A13/A14 blue-endpoint half/half marginals conditional on either first result, and the two endpoint outcomes satisfy their source parity relation.

Partial action is explicitly conditioned on the same actual first projector and reports only flux-free local second-site probabilities; defer has no E2. Never infer a full binary 24-site public record from local marginals.
No stochastic histories, schedule-arm evaluations, bootstrap replicates, risk contrast or threshold inference.
stop_rule: Fail closed if an eligibility, normalization, source limiting-law, action binding or exact expectation check fails. A pass authorizes a separately registered full-record joint law and first-record-aware public adapter, not five-round sampling.
